name: Upwork

buyer.notes: up to 7.99% on the Basic plan; 3% for qualifying US bank-account billing

fees.notes: Seller fee is 0% to 15% per contract, shown before the proposal and fixed for the contract.

bidCost.notes: 0.15 USD each; Connects per job vary; boosted proposals cost extra; not refunded on rejection, withdrawal or expiry; refunded when the client cancels before a contract or Upwork removes the post.

splitMechanism: Fixed-price milestones funded up front; 14-day review then a 5-day security hold.

contactPolicy.notes: Sharing contact info before a contract is circumvention and can cost badges or the account.

automation.officialAutoReply: none; only the API key route is allowed
forbidden: any script, extension or tool acting faster than a human
automation.notes: MCP agents may draft proposals but a human confirms submission.

aiPolicy: AI preference controls govern training on user data; no seller AI-disclosure rule was found (unknown).

onboardingPacing.notes: fsw onboard walks the signup wizard once at a person's pace: a 2.5 to 6 s gap before each action, keys typed 80 to 220 ms apart, page loads 20 s apart and at most one run per 30 minutes. On 2026-10-26 the site signed the operator out after scripts drove its wizard at machine speed. No message is sent.

rankingSignals: Rising Talent and Top Rated badges
